description: Launch a Firefox instance with chrome debugging capabilities enabled.

binaryPath.description: Optional path to the Firefox executable binary.

headless.description: Optional flag to run Firefox in headless mode.

noToolbox.description: Optional flag to disable opening the Browser Toolbox.

profileName.description: Optional name of an existing Firefox profile. If omitted, uses an isolated temporary profile.

toolbox.description: Optional flag to open the Browser Toolbox. Defaults to true unless headless.

name: launch_browser
